description:
IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZED for native-Web configuration by the user on 2026-11-26. No commits, pushes, publication or delivery implementation authorized. Keep this issue in progress through the existing UX/E2E/finalization gates.

Implemented scope in feat/channel-file-settings (uncommitted):
- Existing Web.Delivery owns pure native declaration metadata, translated by WebBridge.capability_snapshot/1 and normalized by CommunicationBridge. Per-file bytes and attachment count are configurable, typed positive integers with unresolved ceilings. Count is required only when file support is usable. File support remains unsupported, transfer mode unresolved, and attachment editing false. Other limits are not invented or blanket not_applicable.
- Zaq.System owns one JSON value in existing system_configs at system.communication.web.file_delivery. No ChannelConfig row, user/conversation/agent setting, new table, module, adapter, Action, validator or resolver.
- Existing Engine.Api system-config event family has guarded native get/save operations, requiring confidential current BO actor. Existing capability endpoint proposal scope narrowly accepts native web/kind retrieval/exact file_delivery map without connector identity; other connector checks remain intact. Management snapshots and Save reuse the same proposal acquisition.
- Save serializes missing-row creation and partial merges under a singleton row lock, normalizes using FileSettings, validates final proposed values through the fresh shared snapshot/Ecto pipeline, and atomically upserts with existing System.set_config. Supplied fields are validated even while support is unavailable; blank optional fields clear overrides. Stored values, independent transport ceilings and failure policy remain distinct. Corrupt storage and internal capability failures return bounded errors.
- Existing SystemConfigLive/GlobalTab expose Global → BO chat with ConnectionSettings and FileDeliverySettings. Cached-only validation, authoritative Save, exact MB presentation, field errors, draft-preserving retries, initial-load recovery and Cancel no-write use existing components and GlobalEvents presentation state. Existing Storybook variation extended.

Scope boundary: actual native attachment transport, authenticated file serving and live/history rendering are separate downstream issue zaq-h2i.5. It must consume this exact settings store through TransportRequirements.resolve/2 once per attempt, and may attest support only after actual delivery implementation/testing. WebWidget remains separately tracked in zaq-h2i.4.2.

Validation evidence: declaration tests failed before replacement then passed; System persistence tests failed before APIs then passed. Integrated 1098 checks passed (18 properties, 1080 tests), /tmp/zaq-native-integrated.log. Includes real concurrent cold saves on independent SQL connections, final DB failure rollback, singleton/no-channel identity, exact values, validation conditional on support, authorization/confidentiality, final proposed/cached distinction, draft/retry/Cancel, SMTP/widget and existing System suites. Committed test assertions remain intact. mix q passed /tmp/zaq-native-final-q.log; git diff --check passed. Full existing browser suite is running; no new feature E2E authored.

UI inspection: no browser errors or desktop overflow. Main /tmp/zaq-native-web-main.png, Advanced /tmp/zaq-native-web-advanced.png, source Storybook /tmp/zaq-native-web-storybook.png. Existing UX approval zaq-h2i.3.4 remains open; consolidated feature E2E zaq-h2i.3.5 remains blocked on it. Coverage/final precommit gate stays in existing owner zaq-h2i.3.13. Implementation agreement does not self-approve UX. No final mix precommit while implementation/review/UX/E2E/coverage prerequisites remain pending.

Reuse assessment: System.Config changeset/unique key and System.set_config final upsert; FileSettings normalization/metadata/Ecto validation/conversion/error helpers; existing Bridge snapshot endpoint and shared normalizer; existing NodeRouter/Event and BOActor management auth; existing GlobalTab/SystemConfigLive/GlobalEvents and components. Existing email/widget/connector Actions do not fit this global owner; approved local administrative configuration extension stays in existing System/Engine owners and is not exposed as an agent/workflow tool. Necessary helpers inspected/justified in child issues; no new production module/framework.

comments.text: Live audit: working in requested existing feat/channel-file-settings at bfb3e677c; worktree clean. PR_STACK.md is absent from all four relevant worktree roots, so verified live ancestry directly (capabilities → settings → dark-theme → delivery_plan). No branch/history edits planned. Action reuse assessment: extend existing WebBridge.capability_snapshot/1 built-in native-Web declaration, reuse Bridge.capability_snapshot normalization/event, CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2, FileSettings, resolver and authorized persistence owners unchanged. Web.Delivery is a validated delivery-descriptor owner (bo/1, events/new/reference), not a configuration declaration API; Response and final_payload/send_reply confirm no attachment sending. Keep metadata beside the existing native profile rather than add an unnecessary public accessor or file-specific callback. Native file limits will be fixed/not_applicable, typed bytes/count, required false; transfer mode unresolved and attachment edits false. Current WebWidget.HostAdapter at locked 42b7ef71 exposes only infrastructure/runtime/ingress/installation APIs, with no capabilities or file declarations; preserve its unresolved metadata and current support meanings. No new API/module/Action/UI/validator/dependency changes. Add original tests only for producer purity, native vs widget semantics, shared controls and persistence rejection/rollback; usable-file required/positive/bounds cases remain covered by existing foundation tests and cannot be claimed as native-Web support.

Additional boundary evidence: ChannelConfig @valid_providers excludes native web; BO ChatLive supplies a configless Delivery.bo/1 descriptor. Native Web has no persisted connector/Advanced form to wire. Do not add one for metadata. Native declarations will be proven through the real Bridge normalization and existing shared component/validator/resolver. Existing configured widget persistence will be regression-tested using production WebBridge, remaining unsupported/unresolved until external declarations exist. No valid native file override or usable-file required-field path exists to test truthfully. This subset is an explicit external-source limitation, not permission to invent support.

Implementation evidence: five native-Web limits now explicitly fixed/not_applicable with integer bytes/count metadata; transfer mode unresolved and attachment edits false. All existing support statuses remain intact. Added producer/envelope, shared component, no-settings-derived-ceilings property and production WidgetConnectorSettings atomic rollback/selected-config/blank-save regressions; no existing test lines removed or behavioral assertions changed. TDD: producer + component tests failed before implementation (18/21 passed) in /tmp/zaq-h2i-4-1-red.log; focused post-fix 21 passed (1 property) plus widget suite 20 passed (1 property). mix q initially reported two new-test alias suggestions; code-quality skill applied local aliases only and rerun passed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-4-1-q.log). Broader regressions running. Added dependency .4.2 → .4.1 for remaining WebWidget integration; do not close this issue as fully complete.

Final issue-level validation: 678 passed (17 properties, 661 tests), /tmp/zaq-h2i-4-1-regression.log. Includes production Web delivery/adapter suites, Channels API/shared normalization/SMTP, resolver, FileSettings, ChannelConfig final-preparation rollback, grouped policy/widget/email persistence, shared controls and widget/SMTP LiveViews. mix q passed; git diff --check passed. Existing assertions preserved; no new production module/helper/API/UI/save path or dependency changes. No browser suite rerun: no rendered route or UI implementation changed (native Web has no persisted settings route); existing component/LiveView suites passed, and existing feature UX/new-E2E/coverage/final precommit gates remain in their owners. Native subset is ready for review; remaining WebWidget subset genuinely depends on external source .4.2, so .4.1 remains in progress with that blocker. No commits, pushes or publication performed.

Proposed plan materialized as sequential children: zaq-h2i.4.1.1 → zaq-h2i.4.1.2 → zaq-h2i.4.1.3 → zaq-h2i.4.1.4. The first child is the explicit user-agreement gate; no implementation continuation this turn. Reuse assessment and concrete missing Engine/native-proposal contracts are in the updated current description. Native configuration is independent of WebWidget .4.2. Graph: agreement → native declarations/proposal contract → System persistence → shared BO Advanced. Tests are included in each owner step, followed by existing feature UX/new-E2E/coverage/final gates.

Module-context phase complete: System owns global DB key/value state; System.Config owns Ecto row validation/unique key. Engine.Api owns authorized event orchestration; BO GlobalTab/SystemConfigLive owns presentation/drafts only. Flow: BO Event → Engine authenticated boundary → System transaction → exact proposed capability Event → Bridge/Web.Delivery declaration → CommunicationBridge/FileSettings Ecto validation → Config row. Runtime defaults cannot come from form/cached facts. Existing System.set_config provides final upsert; existing helpers writing several scalar fields do not fit one JSON value and ignore result errors, so native save needs a small transaction/row-lock composition with explicit result handling. New helper candidates/necessity: native declaration projection in existing Delivery; decode one JSON setting shared by get/save; shared proposal snapshot acquisition used by management read/save. No new production modules. Downstream transport is tracked in zaq-h2i.5.
